origin.source: Published benchmark protocols and evaluation code cited in the setting records.

scope: Descriptive audit of inspected benchmark designs and reporting, extended by the separate numerical and artifact analyses in experiments/2026-10-05. Null means not assessed for this setting, not absence of capability.

eligible_populations.clarification: Eight specified conversational settings. BIRD-History is retrieval context, not user clarification.
eligible_populations.coverage_risk: Four selected settings: CLARITY multi-turn, TrustSQL, SCARE, ABISS predicted-category. Does not assert exhaustive eligibility.
eligible_populations.interpretation_recovery: AmbiQT and AMBROSIA, for simultaneous alternative recovery. TIDE-Bench intent drift is a changed request.

qualifications.Given history: Completed clarification history is provided before SQL generation; this does not test question selection.
qualifications.Model-generated questions: The protocol allows the model to generate clarification questions. This does not by itself establish their quality.
qualifications.Given + generated: TIDE-Bench L1-primed gives first-layer resolution before the model asks about the second layer.
qualifications.Derivable: SQL-attempt coverage and error among attempts can be calculated for the same population using benchmark-specific error definitions. TrustSQL excludes two inconsistent cells. SCARE treats the two answerable categories separately and accounts for rounded scores.
qualifications.Insufficient aggregates: The inspected reports lack aligned statistics needed for both measures on the same population; this is a reporting limit, not a claim about protocol capability.
qualifications.No distinctness check found: The four inspected AmbiQT generators at revision 2dd908bd4a7173f98fa6637758f4d41852722a5c do not check whether alternative reference outputs differ. This does not establish equal outputs.
qualifications.Distinct, nonempty required: AMBROSIA construction requires distinct, nonempty full reference outputs. Two duplicate-reference exceptions were found. The rule need not hold under every prediction matcher or output projection.
qualifications.Execution match: Both recovery benchmarks use execution matching. AmbiQT also reports exact-set matching. Neither is an independent score of meaning coverage.

records.grouping_reason: Both variants generate clarification questions; early stopping differs. Counted together only in this descriptive audit.

records.coverage_risk_scope: Consistent method-dataset cells only. Two inconsistent cells are excluded.
Two answerable categories, calculated separately with rounding-compatible source scores.

grouping: 12 audited settings from 10 studies. Sphinteract CQs and CQs & ES form one audit group; Simple feedback is excluded. TIDE-Bench and BIRD-INTERACT each contribute two protocols. A setting can appear under several checks.

local_presentation.main: Perspective connection analysis and benchmark reconstructions, connected to the existing audit
local_presentation.appendix: Full 13-setting matrix with citations for every benchmark, plus criteria and derivations

verification_boundary: This 12-setting audit describes selected protocols and reporting. It is separate from the 89-setting perspective map and numerical benchmark analyses. Source checks and record consistency do not rerun models or validate all interpretations.

context_only_comparisons.reason_excluded_from_audit: Retrieval-only comparison. None of the four Table 1 checks was applied. Retained in the appendix comparison table and literature collection.
